system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.
region_name: Global land surface and user-defined regional study areas

data_description.dataset_name: ERA5-Land Monthly Aggregated - ECMWF Land Climate Reanalysis

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global land-surface reanalysis coverage; users may subset any basin, station network, ecological region or other land study area.

data_description.temporal_coverage: 1950-01-01 to present in the ERA5-Land monthly aggregated collection, subject to the catalog holdings at evaluation time.
analytical_capabilities: Analyse monthly precipitation, snowfall, evapotranspiration, runoff and air-temperature fields
Analyse monthly soil-moisture and land-surface variables where the collection band is available
Compute monthly anomalies, trends, drought indices, lagged relationships and water-balance terms
Validate monthly reanalysis variables against station, hydrological, groundwater, lake-level or ecological observations
Aggregate monthly fields over basins, ecological regions, stations and other user-defined geometries

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Monthly ERA5-Land land-surface meteorological and hydrological fields; units depend on the selected band (for example mm for accumulated precipitation/runoff and °C or K for temperature).
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR and select the band matching the research question. Keep accumulated bands (for example total_precipitation_sum and runoff_sum) distinct from monthly mean bands. If starting from the hourly collection, aggregate explicitly to monthly before analysis.

data_description.data_source: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF), distributed through Google Earth Engine and the Copernicus Climate Data Store
